# function: rules

Checks that the rules are well formed, that component overrides only tighten the scheme's constraints, and that the `fit` component has room. Returns the rules, ready to pass to `format`, so mistakes surface where the rules are defined instead of on the first `format` call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  naming = provider::naming::scheme(
    "{org}-{env}-{region}-{type}-{name}",
    { org = "acme", region = "weu" },
    { env = { max_length = 4 }, type = { max_length = 4 } },
  )

  # Storage accounts: lowercase letters and digits only, 3-24 characters.
  storage_account = provider::naming::rules(local.naming, {
    lowercase  = true
    remove     = "[^a-z0-9]"
    min_length = 3
    max_length = 24
  })
}

# acmeprodweustdata
output "storage_account_name" {
  value = provider::naming::format(local.naming, { env = "prod", type = "st", name = "data" }, local.storage_account)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
rules(config object, rules dynamic) object
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Object) A scheme, as returned by `scheme`.
1. `rules` (Dynamic) Rules: `lowercase`, `remove`, `min_length`, `max_length`, `fit` and `components`.
